description: Baltimore Metro SubwayLink Stations is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Maryland Transit Administration (MTA) Metro Subway Stops. Ridership data is based on MTA's Fiscal Year 2019. See for more information. Last Updated: 10/2019. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are maryland open data, maryland transit, subway stops, maryland, stops ridership. The table has 12 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
